patterns.reminder: FindMYJob red line: never use $queryRawUnsafe or $executeRawUnsafe. Use $queryRaw / $executeRaw tagged templates or Prisma.sql, quote table and column names, and escape backslash, % and _ before user input goes into ILIKE. ESLint (no-restricted-properties) and db:check also block this.

NEXT_PUBLIC_* variables are shipped to every browser. Never put secrets, tokens, passwords or private keys there. Only public values (Sentry DSN, Turnstile site key) may use the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix; keep the secret half server-only in src/env.ts.

This looks like a hardcoded FindMYJob secret. Secrets live only in /opt/findmyjob/env/*.env on the server (and in two people's password managers); locally the human copies env.example to .env. Read secrets through src/env.ts. Never commit them, never put them in Docker ARG/ENV/COPY or CI files, and never add a gitleaks allowlist entry to get past the pre-commit hook.

FindMYJob red line: employer-side companyId must come from requireCompanyMember(), never from params, query, form data or the request body. The only exception is a public resource keyed by company id (for example the logo proxy), which must not return private data.

Better Auth baseline (ARCHITECTURE 5.11): no wildcard trustedOrigins, no disableCSRFCheck, useSecureCookies stays on in production, cookieCache stays off, role and status are input:false, requireEmailVerification stays on. Any new /api/auth path must be covered by Turnstile and rate limiting.

Pages under /s, /e, /admin and code in src/server must not use 'use cache', unstable_cache or force-static: a shared cache can serve one user's data (or PII) to another. Logged-in and PII responses need Cache-Control: private, no-store and X-Robots-Tag: noindex.
